patient was apparently asymptomatic 1 week ago then she developed fever which is sudden in onset, high grade, associated with chills and rigor. It relieves temporarily on taking medication.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPalpitations are present since 1 week which are regular and associated with discomfort in the chest.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThere is history of shortness of breath on exertion which is progressive. There is no orthopnea and paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis is associated with generalized weakness since 4 days and Blood in stools since 3 days.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThere is no history of vomitings, loose stools, pain abdomen, giddiness.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan
